parameter_reviews.name: sim.inplane_count_floor_fraction

declaration.source: positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

parameter_reviews.name: sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters

declaration.source: numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.
